eventDescription:
The tree plantation event was successfully conducted at the playground of Arignar Anna Government Boys Higher Secondary School, jointly organized by Vidhaigal, SRM Tamil Perayam, Parivendar Students? Forum, and NSS students.
The event aimed to inspire students to care for nature and encourage their active participation in environmental conservation.
